title: Thumb wheel
about: A 50 mm thumb wheel, like the focus wheel on a pair of binoculars: a ring and a raised hub, each a rectangle revolved round the middle, and a knurled rim from one small cut repeated 24 times round.
picture_alt: A flat wheel with a knurled rim and a raised hub
steps: sketch.constrain sketch=WheelSketch kind=length on=Line1 value=22 name=Ring
sketch.constrain sketch=WheelSketch kind=length on=Line2 value=6 name=Thickness
sketch.constrain sketch=HubSketch kind=length on=Line1 value=5 name=HubWidth
sketch.constrain sketch=HubSketch kind=length on=Line2 value=4 name=HubHeight
feature.add_revolve sketch=HubSketch axis=y operation=join body=Wheel name=Hub

expect.ThumbWheel: pi*(R**2 - ri**2)*T + pi*(rh**2 - ri**2)*hh - 24*lens(R, rk, R)*T

change.about: raise the hub to 7 mm instead of 4 mm (HubSketch's HubHeight): the revolve follows the rectangle.
